highlights:
Side-zip entry: A visible side zipper opens the ankle-height upper, offering an alternative to lace fastening.

Textured upper panels: Creased surface details, curved side seams and a rear-quarter panel define the casual boot profile.

Sculpted PVC sole: The source identifies the sole as PVC. Raised sidewall sections and the stitched-looking toe outline give the boot a pronounced utility-inspired shape.

Rear pull loop: A visible loop above the heel provides a place to grip the boot when putting it on.

Assortment planning: Black, Grey and Khaki are listed in EU38-45. Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
